name: Golden State Skinheads
description: Golden State Solidarity (also known as Golden State Skinheads) is a California-based racist skinhead group, active primarily in the Sacramento area. The group espouses white nationalist ideology and has been involved in violent incidents, most notably the 2016 Sacramento riot staged in conjunction with the Traditionalist Workers Party. It is closely affiliated with Volksfront, American Front, and Hammerskin Nation.
